description.en: Sets a character's motion to a walk/run animation and moves it towards a target position at the given speed, instead of a fixed-duration move like EvLowMdlMove.
Handle of the character model to move.
2-element array [speedValue, motionName] with the movement speed and the walk/run motion name to play (e.g. S_WALK_01).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Walk a character towards a position at a given speed
EvLowMdlRunWalk(hTenmaL, pos, S_WALK_01);
